title: Microsoft Defender Hunt
description: Executes OpenCTI hunts on Microsoft Defender XDR. OpenCTI dispatches one hunt run per hunt and time window; the connector translates the canonical Sigma rule of the hunt into KQL with pySigma (Microsoft Defender XDR pipeline) or runs the native KQL query written for Microsoft Defender XDR, executes it with the advanced hunting API of Microsoft Graph over the run window within the run timeout, the result limits and the advanced hunting quotas, and reports the run to OpenCTI. When the hunt matches, the techniques and indicators of the hunt are sighted on the Microsoft Defender XDR Security Platform and the IOC observables found in the results are sent as observed-data. Indicator hunts look up their IP addresses, domains, host names, URLs, email addresses and MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 file hashes in the device, email, identity and cloud app tables, and report each value seen, not seen or not searched. Raw events never leave the tenant: OpenCTI only receives counts and truncated evidence, per field and per hit. Before you start: a Microsoft Entra ID app registration with the Microsoft Graph application permission ThreatHunting.Read.All, admin consent granted. The least-privilege permissions, the console steps and a copy-ready configuration are at https://docs.opencti.io/latest/usage/hunt-connectors/#microsoft-defender-xdr, and Test connection on the connector page in OpenCTI checks them.
short_description: Runs OpenCTI hunts (Sigma translated to KQL, native KQL, indicator lookups) on Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting and reports hits, observed IOCs and redacted evidence.
